name: io.github.augbastos/deputy-mcp
title: Deputy MCP
description: Deputy workforce data for AI agents: rosters, timesheets and shifts; read-only by default

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token mode (all tools): a Deputy API token, created with an admin access level. Pair with DEPUTY_BASE_URL. Configure exactly one of the three authentication modes: API token, OAuth, or iCal feed.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API token mode: your Deputy install origin, e.g. https://your-company.eu.deputy.com.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth mode (all tools, no admin needed): client id of a personal app registered at https://once.deputy.com/my/oauth_clients with redirect URI http://localhost:8823/callback. Run 'deputy-mcp login' once.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth mode: client secret of the same app.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_CALENDAR_URL
environmentVariables.description: iCal feed mode (your own roster only, read-only): your personal Deputy calendar link. It contains a private token.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register the write tools (API token and OAuth modes). Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: DEPUTY_TOKEN_STORE
environmentVariables.description: OAuth mode: file path for a plaintext token store, only where no OS keychain is available. Default: the OS keychain.
